content.title: WWE WrestleMania 42 start time: Here's how to watch matches for Night 2 on Sunday
content.text: Wrestling's biggest event still has one more night to go. WWE WrestleMania 42 wrapped up Night 1 on Saturday with a main event headlined by Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton in Las Vegas. Rhodes outlasted Orton in a grueling match, but ended the night in a daze after Orton hit him with the title belt and then delivered his signature punt to the head as the show went off the air.Now, attention turns to Sunday night where six matches are scheduled to take place. Four of those see titles on the line.Follow WWE WrestleMania 42 results from Night 2 with live updates on Sunday.In the main event, world heavyweight champion CM Punk takes on Roman Reigns, the man with longest championship reign in over 30 years. Reigns earned his spot by winning the Royal Rumble in January. He then chose to face Punk instead of Rhodes, citing their long history of hatred toward the other. Recently, it stems back to Punk being called on to help Reigns and The Usos at Survivor Series in 2024 by longtime advisor Paul Heyman. Punk then used his favor to get Heyman in his corner at last year's WrestleMania when he faced Reigns and Seth Rollins. Now, the hatred has continued with Punk invoking Reigns' deceased father in the feud and saying he would bury Reigns next to him. This hostility brought out the Usos to defend the family name, which set off a chain reaction of attacks for weeks. In the final episode of Raw before WrestleMania, the two apologized for what was said, but did say the hatred still burned. Ranking every WWE WrestleMania of all time: Where each of the 42 events lands after latest edition Brent Brookhouse Also on Sunday, Penta must defend his intercontinental title in a six-pack ladder match with the likes of Je'Von Evans, Dragon Lee, JD McDonagh, Rusev and Rey Mysterio all gunning for the belt hung above the ring. Plus, WWE women's champion Jade Cargill will defend her crown against former champ Rhea Ripley in a grudge match after Cargill enlisted Michin and B-Fab as cohorts to slow down Ripley. And United States champion Sami Zayn will look to defend his title against Trick Williams, who will have Lil' Yachty in his corner. Plus, a titanic clash opens the night when Oba Femi takes on legend Brock Lesnar. Femi has run roughshod over both Raw and SmackDown since making his main roster debut. He then answered Lesnar's open challenge for anyone to face him at WrestleMania, which has led to some of the wildest encounters ahead of the event. Below is how you can catch all the action on Saturday night.
